title: Convair KINGFISH three-view technical drawing (CIA OXCART history, Chapter 6, p. 271)
description: Boxed three-view line drawing of the Convair KINGFISH reconnaissance aircraft design, showing plan, front and side views with dimensions of 80'0" span, 73'7" length and 18'4" height. The figure is captioned "Convair KINGFISH." Below, text discusses the design's fiberglass engine inlets and Pyroceram wing leading edges, Lockheed's competing A-12 design, and the 20 August 1959 proposal submissions; the page is marked Secret NOFORN.
